name: Cyber Struve
desc:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Cyber" Spell/Trap from your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 of these cards from your Deck to your hand.
● Machine "Cyber" monster, except a Level 6 monster
● Spell/Trap that mentions "Cyber Dragon"
You cannot activate monster effects the turn you activate this effect, except Machine "Cyber" monsters'. You can only use this effect of "Cyber Struve" once per turn.
